informalMarkdown:
# Functions

## Reserve a bed

A guest reserves a bed for one night and names an arrival time. How long the hostel keeps that bed after the named arrival time is not stated.

# Data Resources

## Reservation

The reservation records the guest, the bed, and the named arrival time.

# Constraints

## One night

The reservation covers one night.
